en: Waitress
Welcome to the theater café! The stage is dark today, but our tea is always hot.
Waitress
The performers come in here after a show, still wearing their Props. It's quite a sight!
Waitress
Shh! The owner is rehearsing a new number upstairs. He says it will be his best ever.
Fan
I've seen every musical this season. My favourite was the one with a Lillipup in a top hat!
Girl
When I grow up, I want to dress Pokémon for the stage. Ribbons, crowns, glasses, the lot!
Battle Girl
My Pokémon battles hard all week. On Sundays it dances. Everyone needs a hobby!
Socialite
The dressing room is through there. Only performers and their Pokémon may go in, darling.
Dancer
One, two, spin! I'm practising my steps. The Pokémon on stage can't be the only ones who dance!
Gentleman
I am the owner of this theater. A musical is music, dance and costume all at once. Pokémon shine in all three!
Little Girl
Mummy said if I'm good we can watch the next show from the front row!
Pokéfan
My Pokémon got a standing ovation last week! I've still got the programme in my wallet.
Gentleman
I came to Nimbasa for the stadiums, but I keep finding myself back here. Funny, isn't it?
Lady
The Props are the best part. A Pokémon in a tiny hat is the most charming thing in Unova.
Policeman
Keeping an eye on the stage door. Some fans get a little too excited after a show!

Today's show: closed for rehearsals
